notes: Whole Allan Cunningham Monument at Cunningham’s Gap: stone obelisk/cairn, integral stepped cement-rendered base, three south-facing marble plaques and its low post-and-single-rail enclosure. Forest, highway, natural mountain, tourist shelter and later unrelated monuments are excluded. A primary-text reconstruction of the simple structure; main height/base dimensions follow the Queensland heritage authority. Taper, step divisions, stone pattern, plaque sizes, enclosure size and small fittings are bounded estimates. No archive photograph used or photographic fidelity claimed.
